analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 유지, ADX 추세 강도 유지
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold, holding neutral; ADX trend strength maintained
analysis.reason: RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나 여전히 40 이하 수준. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간. ADX는 37.4로 뚜렷한 추세를 나타내지만, -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 우세. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 비율 0.52로 위축된 거래량은 방향성 결정에 대한 신뢰도를 낮춤. 현재가 $54.01은 볼린저밴드 중단선 $55.11 아래 위치. 스윙 지지선 $53.20, 저항선 $54.25 사이에서 횡보 국면 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold territory but remains below 40. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative. ADX at 37.4 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting downward pressure. Volume ratio of 0.52 (below 5-day average) weakens conviction for directional moves. Current price $54.01 is below the Bollinger Band middle line at $55.11. The price is consolidating between swing support at $53.20 and resistance at $54.25.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 RSI 47.1로 중립 구간, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 음수 유지. 일봉 지표와 큰 충돌 없음.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 47.1 is neutral, and the weekly MACD histogram remains negative. No major conflict with daily indicators.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($54.01) vs SMA5/20/50 ($53.65/$55.11/$55.59): Above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/50, indicating a transition phase.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($55.00)/SMA200 ($53.33): Mixed mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (58.0%) + Current price level is historically intermediate.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.5→35.3): Confirmed exit from oversold and entry into neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2548→-0.1061): Improvement from negative territory confirmed, no signal of trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle line $55.11): Below the middle line, band width at 8.90% is normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($53.20): Based on moving averages (SMA200) and 5-day low.
· Swing resistance ($54.25): Based on 5-day high and Pivot Point (PP); a breakout could signal an upward turn.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Consolidation within the 5-day high/low range, potential for Higher Low formation relative to 20-day low.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.52x): Below 5-day average volume reduces conviction for directional moves.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Continued sideways movement within support/resistance; awaiting a breakout with accompanying volume.
